To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the share of the urban informal economy is inversely related to the level of urban population.

there is an inverse U-shaped relationship between urbanization and the size of the urban informal economy and that the level of urban informal employment tends to fall in countries with high levels of taxes, low trade openness, and weak institutional quality.
the share of urban informal sector increases with urbanization in the early stages of urbanization but tends to decrease in the later stages of urbanization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between urbanization and the informal sector and the factors that affect the informal sector.
the relationship between urbanization and the size of the urban informal sector.
the relationship between urbanization and informal economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the informal sector in developing countries is not a permanent feature of the economic landscape.
the informal economy is an integral part of the economic landscape in urban areas, and that it is a necessary part of economic development.
the informal economy tends to grow in the early phases and then tends to decline in later phases of urbanization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
urbanization has a non-linear relationship with the size of informal sector.
the urbanization process tends to reduce the size of informal economy.

the size of the urban informal economy is not only a function of urbanization but it is also a function of other factors such as the level of development, trade openness, taxes, and institutional quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
policymakers should be cautious when formulating policies to promote urbanization as the size of the urban informal sector is not necessarily a bad thing.
the informal economy is not a permanent feature of urban areas and can be reduced by appropriate policies.
urbanization can help to reduce the size of the shadow economy.
